imageStyle: Loose hand-drawn editorial sketch on warm cream paper (#f2e7d3) with a soft dark vignette at the top. The main subject in confident black ink lines with light cross-hatching and cartoon motion marks (sweat drops, speed lines, little shake strokes). Background people as soft grey washed silhouettes in graphite tones, slightly out of focus. One or two key objects picked out in warm ochre and amber watercolour washes (#c8892f) with tiny glow strokes around them. A thin inked ground line with a few scribbled grass tufts. Muted palette: cream, graphite greys, black ink, ochre. Expressive, a little humorous, lots of empty paper; no clean vector shapes, no flat colour fills, no photorealism, no 3D.
